title: My alarm is too quiet
body:
Issue: The volume of my alarm is too quiet.

The volume of the alarm can be adjusted, but must be done so in two places.

First, adjust the volume in your iPhone's Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Ringtone and Alerts. This controls the volume of the alarm while your iPhone is locked.

Second, adjust the volume in the Lasso app itself. Open Lasso's Settings > Volume. This controls the volume after you've responded to the alert on your Lock Screen. Match the volume in both places for a seamless transition.

If your alarm is still quiet after adjusting the volume to a reasonable level, another setting may be affecting your volume. Check the following settings. If you're still having issues with alarm volume, use the contact button below to reach out to us.

Wake Up: If Lasso's Wake Up feature is set to Gradual, the alarm will be very quiet at first, but will slowly increase to the set volume. If you prefer the alarm to play at the set volume instantly, select 'Instant' in Lasso's Settings > Wake Up.

Attention Aware Features: If 'Attention Aware Features' is toggled on in your iPhone's Settings > Face ID & Passcode, the alarm volume may be lowered, but only while you're iPhone is unlocked and you are looking at the screen.

Limit Maximum Volume: If 'Limit Maximum Volume' is enabled in your iPhone's Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Volume Limit, it could be reducing the volume of the alarm after you've unlocked your iPhone. However, this should not affect the volume while the iPhone is locked.

Reduce Loud Sounds: If 'Reduce Loud Sounds' is enabled in your iPhone's Settings > Sounds & Haptics, it could be reducing the volume of the alarm after you've unlocked your iPhone. However, this should not affect the alarm volume while your iPhone is locked.
